description: Runs one already-configured AI or web-research column and saves a generated value for each requested row. Takes the column's exact ai: id and, optionally, the rowIds to run. It costs 1 credit per row for an AI column and 6 per row for a web-research column (aiKind "web", which reads the company's site and searches the web, citing its source); the column's creditsPerRow says which. The result's creditsCharged says how many were spent.
name: run_sheet_ai_column
title: Executar coluna de IA
